meta.about: Elements and pen trajectory of the copybook letters (docs/propis2-letter-parts.md, owner 2026-11-19). The letter shapes stay in wide.json; this file only marks, per stroke of a letter, which stretches of its path are a RETRACE (the pen goes on the paper along the line of an element — one already drawn, р: back up the stick; or the one it is about to write, и: up the line its second stick then comes down — written without a lift, adding no ink of its own) and where an element begins without one (`cuts`). Positions are counted in path segments from the stroke's start (2 = the point where the 2nd segment after M ends; 2.5 = the middle of the 3rd by its curve parameter; {"seg": 2, "y": 36} = the first point after segment 2 at the height 36 — guide lines in the capture frame: 10 the top of the small letters, 36 the middle dashed line, 62 the baseline). The ink between them, in writing order, are the letter's elements. {"seg": 9, "top": true} = the highest point of the 10th segment (a cut at the top, л м).
meta.techniques: joined (default, owner): the path as captured, retraces run along the ink and add none; lifted: every element on its own, from its own start dot; the pen's way through the air between them is not shown
